text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Businessman Horacio Roque has joined Spanish tobacco company Tabacalera in the bidding for Portuguese tobacco company Tabaqueira which the government is privatisating.
- Right-wing Popular Party (PP) deputy Paulo Portas has refused to become PP parliamentary leader after an indecisive vote.
- French car company Renault wants to change its image in Portugal by reinforcing the quality of its products.
- Public Works Minister Joao Cravinho has presented the government's economic plans for 1997 to trade unions.
- Oil companies Shell, Mobil and BP are to take stakes in Petrogal subsidiary CLC at the end of October.
- The centre-right Social Democratic Party (PSD) is sceptical about the government's macroeconomic goals for 1997 which Public Works Minister Joao Cravinho presented on Monday.
- Portuguese companies join Spain's Tabacalera in the race for tobacco company Tabaqueira. French company Seita is also bidding.
- Government proposes lowering the number of days when sardines can be caught to keep fleet and jobs in Portugal.
